asha_cs: FYI — MeridianPay flagged as renewal risk. Usage down ~72% since last Friday after their security audit. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/accounts/meridianpay/usage :warning:

ops_bot: Alert • usage-drop-detection — account=meridianpay pct_drop=72 timeframe=7d

ravi_csm: On it. Quick facts: active seats 42 -> 17, champion (Lena) left 3 weeks ago, onboarding checklist stuck on "SSO config" for 2 teams. No support tickets opened recently.

tom_ae: Sales note: procurement is running a shortlist with RivalAI and CloudPrompt. They're asking about private deployment and SOC2 controls.

michelle_se: Did their integration job fail? I see repeated 401s in the logs around 03/04. Posting snippet:
```
2026-03-05T03:12:07Z ERROR oauth: token expired for client_id=mp-frontend
```

ravi_csm: Good catch. We pinged their IT two days ago but no reply. I tried scheduled ping last night.

asha_cs: Next steps? We should 1) confirm SSO health, 2) schedule exec sync, 3) offer a time-limited private trial (14 days) + assisted SSO setup.

tom_ae: I'll escalate with procurement — want the trial offer to include a dedicated onboarding session + performance & security report. Suggest 10% pilot credit and one onboarding engineer.

michelle_se: I can carve out 2 hours tomorrow to remote into their SSO env. Need contact — @ravi_csm can you share IT contact?

ravi_csm: IT contact is james.harper@meridianpay.com (James H.). I have his number, will DM now.

asha_cs: I'll draft outreach msg. Suggested subject: "Quick SSO check + 14-day private trial to stabilize usage". Anyone want to add talking points? :wave: 

tom_ae: Add note re: SOC2 + private deployment options. Emphasize measurable latency & cost report and an SLA for the pilot.

michelle_se: Also mention we can run a focused health-check: token refresh flows, cache warming, and KV cache warm-up to reduce cold-start errors. Offer to share short runbook.

ravi_csm: I'll book a triage call for tomorrow 10am PST and include James + their PM. If they don't take it, offer an on-demand assisted session with step-by-step docs.

asha_cs: Thanks. Action items:
- asha_cs: draft outreach (ETA 2h)
- ravi_csm: DM IT + book call (ETA 1h)
- michelle_se: confirm SSO debug slot tomorrow (ETA 3h)
- tom_ae: prep pilot credit note for procurement (ETA EOD)

ops_bot: Task created • triage-meridianpay-1717001234 assigned=[asha_cs,ravi_csm,michelle_se,tom_ae]

asha_cs: :pray: keeping this high priority — potential renewal in ~6 weeks. Will update thread after call.
